name: Furen's Notes
summary: In Stormwind, Furen's Notes carry his discoveries in metallurgy and armorsmithing to Alliance craftsmen. Furen Longbeard forged protective gear for veteran warriors, then sent copies to help fellow smiths refine their work.

sections.title: A Master's Discoveries
sections.body: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Furen Longbeard forges specialized armaments for warriors. As he works, he records his methods and discoveries. Dwarven metalworking keeps changing, so he makes several copies for other smiths to use and build upon. His notes describe ways to temper, reinforce, and shape armor against deadly blows.

sections.title: Dispatched Across the Alliance
sections.body: Furen sends copies to trusted contacts among the Alliance's craftsmen. Grimand Elmore may scoff at a smith he claims to have taught, but the notes still hold useful insights. Some copies cross the Great Sea to night elven craftsmen, including Mathiel on Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace. Shared needs in battle bring their different traditions together.

faq.q: What is contained within Furen's Notes?
faq.answer: Furen's Notes describe armorsmithing techniques and discoveries in metallurgy that Furen Longbeard developed while making custom armor for seasoned warriors.
Furen Longbeard is a master dwarven armorsmith in Stormwind's Dwarven District. He guides rising warriors and makes specialized defensive wargear.

faq.q: Why does Grimand Elmore get angry about the notes?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore claims he taught Furen everything the dwarf knows. He resents the suggestion that his former student can teach him something new, though he admits the notes describe techniques worth trying.

faq.q: Who receives copies of Furen's Notes?
faq.answer: Furen sends copies to trusted colleagues across the Alliance, including weapon smith Grimand Elmore in Stormwind, night elven smith Mathiel in Darnassus, and gnomish blacksmith Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.

faq.q: How does Mathiel react to the notes?
faq.answer: Mathiel, a night elf blacksmith on Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace, welcomes Furen's findings with enthusiasm. He sees them as a grand discovery and an honor to bring into his own work.

angles.text: As a warrior, your armor trials in Stormwind lead directly to these notes. They record practical ideas shaped by the needs of frontline combat.
As a blacksmith, you see specialized armorcrafting knowledge pass among dwarven, elven, and gnomish artisans across the Alliance.
